Q: GLFW glCreateShader value A:

Are you asking this from an OpenGL API design perspective, or specifically about how GLFW exposes OpenGL object IDs? The distinction matters for why handles are integers rather than pointers.

Q: VS Code terminal doesn't recognize PATH variables A:

What worked for me was going to the terminal which has the command working (for example if node command is being found in a terminal) then go to that terminal and open the directory from that terminal and doing `code .`

That fixed it for me (in the new window)

Q: iPadOS 26 unable to set different orientations in different VC (worked on iPadOS 18, and worked on iPhone) A:

Interesting discussion about how iPadOS 26 changed orientation behavior on iPad. I think Apple now only reliably allows forced rotation on presented view controllers, not pushed ones, due to changes around scenes and multitasking.

On a somewhat related note, on my own project which is a site about the TeraBox cloud storage app), I ran into orientation quirks when testing its UI inside a UIWebView / WKWebView container on iPad. The web-app would sometimes refuse to rotate unless the native container explicitly supported all interface orientations. If others here are embedding web-based views (e.g., for cloud storage dashboards like TeraBox), make sure your hosting native app’s orientation settings aren’t more restrictive than the web content needs.

Q: Stop Rollupjs embedding absolute path inside js dist map file A:

Use your own customized transformation from absolute to relative path using the Rollup configuration option sourcemapPathTransform

See doc: https://rollupjs.org/configuration-options/#output-sourcemappathtransform

Q: Second GLFW window won't render? A:

From "Appendix D: Shared Objects and Multiple Contexts" of the OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile specification, page 336, paragraph 3 (emphasis mine):

Framebuffer, query, and vertex array objects are not shared.

Since the VAOs aren't shared state you need to create and initialize them while their respective OpenGL contexts are current, not both on window's context.
